title: Each type in the staff room
caption:
Marking, meetings and one kettle shared by forty teachers. Every staff room has the same sixteen people.

One has lessons planned to the end of term. One knows which student is struggling at home and has already helped. One fixed the projector and said nothing. Swipe to find yourself, and your colleagues.

The useful bit: the same sixteen types sit in your classroom. Knowing your own type shows you who you reach naturally, and who you might be missing.

Tag a teacher who deserves a cup of tea.
